summary: Validated the new GET /api/ad-spend-rca/forensic?date=YYYY-MM-DD&providers=... read-only forensic endpoint with 8 new HTTP integration tests covering every spec item. All 11 existing iter251_v10 RCA tests + 23 iter251 phase1/phase2a5/phase2b tests still pass. Total: 42/42 (100%).

minor.issue: Provider filtering loop uses substring match `prov not in src_name and prov != 'google'` — works for current 3 collections (meta_ads_daily contains 'meta', snapchat_account_daily/snapchat_ads_daily contains 'snapchat', tiktok_ads_daily contains 'tiktok') but is brittle; e.g. a future `instagram_ads_daily` collection would not match 'meta' and would still be probed for every other provider. Not a functional bug today but worth a mapping table similar to PROVIDER_SOURCES.

critical_code_review_comments: ad_spend_rca_routes.py now ~600 lines — still under 700-line guideline. Both endpoints share PROVIDER_SOURCES table cleanly. /forensic is correctly read-only (only .find() cursors, no inserts/updates).

All cursors use `{'_id': 0}` projection (counterparties / general_ledger / ad_spend_idempotency / financial_movements / source collections / ads_currency_settings) — verified no Mongo ObjectId leak in response (test_no_mongo_objectid_leak).
/forensic uses limit(200) on GL, limit(300) on idempotency, limit(50) on financial_movements, limit(20) on raw_entries_sample — sensible caps to keep response bounded.

Date bucketing in /forensic at lines 451-461: `target_d = meta.get('spend_date') or meta.get('target_date') or meta.get('ad_spend_date') or (e.get('posted_at') or '')[:10]` — correctly handles missing metadata by falling back to posted_at prefix.

Minor: in per_provider loop (line 494) the condition `prov not in src_name and prov != 'google'` is a bit cryptic — readers might think google has special handling. Consider an explicit provider→collections map (already exists as PROVIDER_SOURCES at top of file). Not blocking.
diagnostics.questions[] returns Arabic/English merchant-facing prose — good UX for the merchant clicking into the forensic JSON.

success_rate.backend: 100% (42/42 — 8 new forensic tests + 11 iter251_v10 RCA + 12 phase2a5 + 6 phase2b + 5 phase1)

test_credentials: Used dynamically registered fresh test users (POST /api/auth/register) for isolation. admin@hesab.app/admin123 from /app/memory/test_credentials.md was available but not needed.
seed_data_creation: Each test module run creates a fresh isolated user, then seeds: 1 meta counterparty (Meta Production, SAR, bank_fee_enabled=true, bank_fee_rate=0.025), 1 snapchat counterparty (name='Snapchat الرياض', USD, external_account_id='snap_prod_acct'), 6 meta_ads_daily rows for 2026-06-23 summing to exactly 510.27 SAR, 1 snapchat_account_daily row {spend:2455.42, spend_native:654.78, fx_rate:3.75, native_currency:'USD'}, 1 ad_spend_idempotency record with key='ad_spend:meta:act_meta_prod:2026-06-23:AM_00_12', 1 ads_currency_settings doc {currency:'USD', rate_to_sar:3.80, source:'manual'}, and ZERO general_ledger ad_spend entries (matches production gap). Module-scope teardown removes ALL records for the isolated test user across 8 collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter251_v11_forensic_rca.py covers all 7 spec items: (1) top-level shape including diagnostics + general_ledger sub-shape, (2) counterparties[] required fields (id/name/ad_provider/external_account_id/currency/bank_fee_enabled/bank_fee_rate/platform_account_ids/is_active/last_sync_at), (3) per_provider[*].source_rows keyed by collection name with rows/spend_sum/spend_native_sum/unique_account_ids/sample, (4) production-matching scenario reproduces 510.27 SAR meta + 2455.42 SAR / 654.78 USD snapchat + 0 GL entries → diagnostics.gl_entries_for_target_date=0, (5) ad_spend_idempotency record with date in key appears in ad_spend_idempotency_for_date with idempotency_keys_for_date>=1, (6) ads_currency_settings USD doc with rate_to_sar=3.80/source='manual' appears in currency_settings, (7) read-only guarantee via count_documents snapshot on 7 collections before/after 4 endpoint calls. Also verified no Mongo _id leak. Counterparties require name_lower (cp_unique_name index) — handled in fixture.

No Mongo _id leak: serialized response does not contain the substring '"_id"'
rca of the issue: n/a — the new /forensic endpoint is correctly implemented and matches the spec. It will help the merchant locate the missing 23/6 GL entries by surfacing (a) which dates DID receive GL posts (gl_dates_present_in_recent), (b) whether ad_spend_idempotency had keys for 23/6 that blocked re-posting, (c) raw source rows count + sum to verify the cron actually ingested data, and (d) currency_settings + bank_fee config on counterparties. The endpoint correctly returned production-like data shape with raw_totals matching the merchant's reported numbers exactly when those data points are present in the source collections.
